about_the_game:
Embark on a Whimsical Retro Quest in Yōsei Wars!

Join Hanoka, a brave hero on a mission to rescue kidnapped tooth fairies from the clutches of mischievous junk food monsters in this fast-paced platformer inspired by arcade classics.

Story

Long ago, harmony reigned between the Tooth Fairies and Junk Food. Fairies collected fallen teeth to harness energy, while Junk Food… made sure those teeth kept falling out.

But peace shattered when the Junk Food turned rogue. During a sacred ritual to the God of Teeth, they stormed the Fairy Castle, capturing every last fairy.

In a forest far away, an explosion jolted Hanoka awake. Drawn by cries for help, she discovered Ice Cream monsters transporting a shipment of stolen teeth—and a trapped fairy.

Dodging sugary foes, Hanoka recovered the teeth. In that moment, lightning surged through her, granting her new powers—unstable, but strong. A single touch now triggered teleportation… always near teeth, the source of her power.

After a daring rescue, Hanoka and the freed fairy vowed to fight back. Thus, the Liberation Force was born—to take down the Junk Food Generals and their twisted Captain General, one tooth at a time.

Features

✨ Charming Retro Action
Dash, jump, and collect sparkling teeth in a high-energy platformer inspired by Game Boy-era classics.

⚡ Harness the Power of Teeth
Grab every tooth in a level to unleash a powerful lightning blast—and liberate the captured fairy!

🎨 Pixel-Perfect Nostalgia
Enjoy handcrafted 8-bit visuals and a catchy chiptune soundtrack by Tacha, all oozing with retro charm.

🕹️ True Arcade Feel
Made with ZGB engine for a faithful 8-bit experience—ideal for retro enthusiasts and newcomers alike.

🍩 Sweet But Deadly Foes
Battle chocolate bars, flying ice creams, soda grenadiers, and more across whimsical and challenging levels.

💎 Loads of extras

An Art Gallery, a Music Player and even the game's "prototypes" are available in-game.
